title: Tape Invariance Under a Frontier Shift
statement: For any integer $z$ and finite lists $l,w,r$ of possibly blank Boolean symbols, the tape represented with frontier $z$, left list $l$, and right list $w$ followed by $r$ is the same function of tape position as the tape represented with frontier $z+|w|$, left list given by the reversal of $w$ followed by $l$, and right list $r$.
hypotheses_covered: $l,w,r$ are finite lists of possibly blank Boolean symbols
replaced:
Moving the frontier of a finite zipper across a segment $w$ --- pushing the
reversal of $w$ onto the processed stack and advancing the frontier by $|w|$
--- leaves the represented tape unchanged.
